repo.description:
### Summary

A type coercion bypass in `UserViewSet.create()` allows any authenticated user with `auth.add_user` permission to create a superuser account.

### Impact

Privilege escalation. Any user with delegated `auth.add_user` permission (commonly granted for user onboarding in multi-user deployments) can create a superuser account.

(Additional content was redacted to reduce exploitation)
repo.summary: Privilege Escalation to Superuser via Bypass in UserViewSet
